newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA'S PHIBOR RATES CONTINUE TO SLIDE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA'S PHIBOR RATES CONTINUE TO SLIDE.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) continued to slide on Friday in anticipation of a further cut in the central bank's overnight rates, dealers said.
"It's also a good sign the (currency) situation could be normalising," a trader said, saying the current PHIBOR rates take into account the view of foreign banks.
Foreign banks were excluded from the foreign exchange spot market to ease the pressure on the peso and they are expected to trade again next week.
Their return would indicate whether the peso had normalised and interest rates could move down further, traders said.
PHIBOR reflects the swap rates between the peso and dollar.
